title: sambucus racemosa subsp. kamtschatica
intro: Sambucus racemosa subsp. kamtschatica, commonly known as Kamchatka Elderberry, is a subspecies of the Sambucus racemosa plant, a flowering plant native to Asia. The Kamchatka Elderberry has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and provide relief from cold and flu symptoms. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Kamchatka Elderberry, such as sambunigrin, sambunigron, and sambunigrin 7-glucoside, contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for natural health remedies.
